text:
maria_g: Quick check — target KMS/HSM cutover planned for Tue 2025-04-08. Need an owners list + any blockers for audit-log continuity. Who can own HSM attestation and the post-cutover verification runbook?
henry: I can own the HSM attestation work and run the verification checklist. Need a clear downtime window from infra.
devon: infra side — we can provide a 2:00–04:00 UTC maintenance window but it requires a prod deploy freeze 24h prior and an oncall rotation. Is that acceptable?
maria_g: 24h freeze should be fine for the cutover sprint. @henry — does attestation require specific CN/CSR updates or just key availability checks?
henry: mostly key availability + signing proof + attestation token exchange. I’ll draft the steps. If we need CSR regen that adds ~30m.
sandeep: Quick reminder — audit-log pipeline must have zero gaps. We need to confirm ingestion from keystore changes is routed to the retention cluster before cutover. Who owns that?
lisa: ops — I have an open PR to update the keystore shim and audit event schema: https://git.company/redwood/keystore/pull/412 . Once merged, it flips a feature flag.
devon: @lisa we can coordinate feature-flag flip during the maintenance window. Need the PR merged + staging smoke pass beforehand.
compliance-bot: Ticket SEC-872 created: "KMS cutover verification". Checklist attached. Link: https://tracker.redwood/sec/872
maria_g: Nice. Can we get owners and explicit action items? I'll summarize: 1) HSM attestation owner = henry; 2) Infra maintenance window = devon to schedule; 3) Keystore shim PR = lisa to land and coordinate feature flag; 4) Audit-log routing confirmation = sandeep to validate retention cluster mapping; 5) Compliance checklist = maria_g to sign off post-run.
henry: I'll post a draft attestation runbook by EOD today. It will include the commands and verification steps.
lisa: Will rebase + request a quick review. Tagging @devops for staging smoke.
sandeep: I'll run a dry ingest test against retention cluster on Mon and post results here.
devon: I'll schedule the 2:00–04:00 UTC slot and create a cal invite with oncall.
maria_g: Thanks — small ask: if anyone sees a dependency risk (backup windows, analytics jobs), call it out now so we can shift the cutover or split phases. :eyes:
henry: One potential risk — analytics batch job kicks off at 03:30 UTC. If that’s immutable, we should either start earlier or pause that job for the window.
devon: Can we pause analytics for that one window? I'll check.
lisa: If pause not possible, we can do phased keystore flip: read-only then switch write. That reduces risk but adds verification steps.
maria_g: Good alternatives. Please update owners with any changes. Will collate into the SEC-872 checklist and ping again tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
